title: Can you use autoregressive diffusion to generate market data?
summary: Jane Street researchers explore using autoregressive diffusion models to generate realistic synthetic market data, testing whether this cutting-edge generative AI technique can capture the complex temporal dependencies and cross-sectional correlations present in financial time series.
problem_solved: Generating realistic synthetic market data for backtesting trading strategies and risk simulation without exposing proprietary or sensitive real market information
why_valuable: Provides a rigorous empirical evaluation from a top quant firm on whether modern diffusion-based generative models can handle the unique challenges of financial data, offering actionable insights for practitioners in algorithmic trading and financial ML
